name: wayfern-connector
description: Connect your AI apps to Wayfern, one memory shared across Claude, Cursor, Codex and more. Talks to the Wayfern app on your Mac.

scripts.bundle: npm run build && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=mcpb/server/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && cp LICENSE mcpb/LICENSE
scripts.test:bundle: npm run bundle && CONNECTOR_BIN=mcpb/server/index.js node --test test/connector.test.js
scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run bundle && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 validate mcpb/manifest.json && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 pack mcpb wayfern-connector.mcpb

author: LF Labs
